raw.query: WITH runs AS (SELECT p.run_id, d.experiment, d.pool, d.window_name, d.window_requests, MIN(p.n_requests) AS min_n_requests, MAX(p.n_requests) AS max_n_requests FROM provenance.v_pool_latency AS p JOIN provenance.v_dim AS d USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND ((d.window_name = 'aggregate' AND d.window_requests = 749601) OR d.experiment = 'a13') GROUP BY p.run_id, d.experiment, d.pool, d.window_name, d.window_requests), classified AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN window_name = 'aggregate' AND window_requests = 749601 THEN 'aggregate' ELSE 'full_trace' END AS cohort, CASE WHEN window_name = 'aggregate' AND window_requests = 749601 THEN 749601 ELSE 1000000 END AS claimed_n FROM runs) SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) AS current_runs, MIN(min_n_requests) AS minimum_observed, MAX(max_n_requests) AS maximum_observed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE min_n_requests <> claimed_n OR max_n_requests <> claimed_n) AS mismatching_runs, ARRAY_AGG(run_id ORDER BY run_id) FILTER (WHERE min_n_requests <> claimed_n OR max_n_requests <> claimed_n) AS mismatching_run_ids FROM classified GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY cohort
